purpose: Preflight the proposed historical/runtime feature-concordance path before its prospective collection start

runtime_source.frames: 200 native bars for each of 1W, 1D, 4H, 1H and 15M

candidate_replay_source.method: Frozen 2020-2026 Dukascopy 15M base plus a separately fetched intraday 15M tail, resampled with research.build_historical_dataset.TF_RULES

representative_findings: Native 1H ATR and 15M-resampled 1H ATR differed at matching event times.
ATR-normalized geometry inherited those source-bar differences.
At least one directional liquidity-sweep object was present in the resampled path and absent in the native path, changing registered missingness fields.

decision_reason: Exact event membership in this small preflight does not rescue incompatible feature values and object missingness. Relaxing tolerances would conceal a representation mismatch.

corrected_native_reference_preflight.limitation: This decision contained no registered event, so it validates exact source-window alignment but cannot satisfy any prospective event-feature coverage gate.

required_correction: Use a delayed, separately fetched native-timeframe replay for the prospective runtime-concordance gate. Treat the rejected 15M-resampled 2020-2026 event models as non-promotable. Any later event model must have a new data and outcome contract aligned with the representation that passes prospective concordance.
